<div class="section-contributors">Contributors: {{{1|}}}</div><noinclude>
On the line after the heading of a section: the people who contributed to the section, the most recent first, in small type. Usage: <code><nowiki>{{Contributed by|Name Surname, Name Surname}}</nowiki></code>; in TeX, <code><nowiki>\contributors{Name Surname, Name Surname}</nowiki></code> after <code><nowiki>\section{...}</nowiki></code>. The editors decide, at their discretion, who is listed, and add a new name at the beginning of the list. See [[How to contribute#Credits|How to contribute]].</noinclude>
